cases.name: read_whoami
cases.note: a read: status ok, the Result in data

cases.name: new_ticket
cases.note: a write: relay.submit of one device-signed ticket.created; idem = event id

cases.name: new_ticket_again_new_rid
cases.note: the same idem under a new rid: the stored outcome, duplicate true

cases.name: outcome_get_committed
cases.note: outcome.get

cases.name: outcome_get_pending
cases.note: no record yet, inside ULID time + 1200 s: pending

cases.name: forbidden_op_http
cases.note: an op outside the closed table: forbidden_scope (checked before the other meta keys)

cases.name: auth_key
cases.note: an auth key: req.invalid

cases.name: grant_shaped
cases.note: a grant-shaped string anywhere: grant.secret_in_args

cases.name: write_without_idem
cases.note: idem.required

cases.name: idem_not_the_event_id
cases.note: idem != events[0].id: invalid.input (14.6 P1)

cases.name: event_expired
cases.note: the event id's ULID time outside [now - 900 s, now + 300 s]: event.expired

cases.name: idem_on_a_read
cases.note: an idem on a read: req.invalid

cases.name: stale_epoch
cases.note: an old epoch whose key is held: sealed under it

cases.name: stale_timestamp
cases.note: outside ±300 s

cases.name: seq_used
cases.note: a used seq: stale_sequence with high

cases.name: malformed_meta
cases.note: a meta without op: malformed, seq not used

cases.name: not_member
cases.note: a device not in the member list

cases.name: bad_signature
cases.note: signed by another key

cases.name: chunked_answer
cases.note: an answer over one chunk: chunk 0 meta {status: ok}, later {}, LAST on the final one

cases.name: answer_write
cases.note: an answer write: relay.submit of one device-signed question.answered (scope decide)

cases.name: ticket_key_not_next
cases.note: the key is not the next free key: C-auto, rebuild with next_key (advisory) under a NEW event id

cases.name: write_failed_ticket_exists
cases.note: a write refused by the host: ticket.exists, D

cases.name: outcome_get_failed
cases.note: outcome.get of a failed write: data.state failed with its error

cases.name: outcome_get_partial
cases.note: outcome.get of a partial record: seqs are events that LANDED, never 'not run'

cases.name: outcome_get_unknown_idem
cases.note: no record and past the event id's ULID time + 1200 s: outcome.unknown_idem, C-review

cases.name: outcome_get_idem_expired
cases.note: a tombstoned idem: idem.expired, B (read the log)

cases.name: write_admitted_not_yet_run
cases.note: admitted (T1), still running: no answer yet

cases.name: outcome_get_pending_admitted
cases.note: outcome.get of an idem this device has admitted: pending

cases.name: same_idem_new_rid_while_running
cases.note: the same signed event + idem on a NEW rid while it runs: refusal pending (B), never a second run

cases.name: request_with_rd
cases.note: rd (H12d) is accepted and carried into the identity; never a qualification in v1.7

cases.name: answer_over_the_relay_budget
cases.note: an answer whose chunk envelopes would exceed the relay's 2 MiB per-device budget: frame.too_large (the 4 MiB-class answer of round 1 is refused up front, never stored)

cases.name: already_done_on_a_read
cases.note: stamped before the host (re)started: already_done {status: unknown}; on a read: re-issue, new rid

cases.name: write_host_field
cases.note: a host-stamped field in the submitted event: validation.event (14.6 P3), D

cases.name: write_schema
cases.note: the F1 event schema refuses the event: validation.event (14.6 P3), D

cases.name: write_text_rule
cases.note: an F1 section 11.3 text rule (a bidi control): validation.text (P3), D

cases.name: write_sig_invalid
cases.note: the event signature does not verify: sig.invalid (14.6 P7), D

cases.name: stale_epoch_under_a_burned_key
cases.note: a request under a burned epoch above the committed one: ONLY a signed stale_epoch under that key, naming the pending epoch, else EHW + 1 (C5, proto 8.5 G2b)

comment: R2 framing vectors (orch-core 11A.5 'R2 framing'); generated by scripts/gen_r2_framing_vectors.py

host.seqs: only for a write whose events LANDED (failed/partial)

retry_notes.already_done: on a read: re-issue under a new rid; on a write: outcome.get with the idem
retry_notes.event.abandoned: a restore abandoned this event id (core's known_or_fresh): review again, a NEW event id
retry_notes.failed: outcome.get state failed without seqs: nothing landed; classify by error.code, never by the state
retry_notes.pending: the idem is admitted or running: no second run; ask outcome.get later (bounded)
retry_notes.ticket.exists: after a C-auto rebuild (a new event id for the same uid): check outcome.get for the first idem
